verdict.rationale: Restate's core value proposition is durable execution: completed steps are persisted to a journal and automatically resumed on failure, crash, or redeploy, with state (Virtual Objects/K/V) surviving across executions, retries of transient errors, and durable timers surviving suspensions on FaaS. This is documented extensively (restate-docs-1,2,15,17,18,21,24) and independently corroborated by hands-on community reports of using it in production-like setups (restate-comm-1,7,9). Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmark/incident report specifically confirming crash-recovery behavior in production at scale, beyond vendor docs and general community enthusiasm.
